{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|So, what caused the blackout?''"<br />"''An electromagnetic storm shut down most of Rhire's power and all of Rhinnal's communications satellites.|[[Bama Vook]] and [[Noro Zak]]|<ref name="TFoDM">''[[Episode I Adventures 3: The Fury of Darth Maul]]''</ref>}}
A '''magnetic storm''', also known as an '''electromagnetic storm'''<ref name="TFoDM" /> and as a '''geomagnetic storm''',<ref name="OaA">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref> was a phenomenon which occurred on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] and [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]],<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Arda I]],<ref name="OaA" /> [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]],<ref name="TCVG">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> and [[Zongorlu]],<ref name="Interference">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/interference20090929.html|text="Interference"|int=Interference|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> on the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]],<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> [[Captivity]]<ref name="TFtF">{{WEGCite|book=The Star Wars Rules Companion|story=To Free the Forgotten}}</ref> and [[Entooine]],<ref name="BC">{{ChallengeCite|70|Bantha Cannon}}</ref> and inside the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]]<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref>
